Name: Bearish Harvey for CP
Author: annachibi2
Description:
[center][size=3]Turn Harvey into a cute bearish type guy! This mod gives Harvey a beard and makes him chubby, affecting both his portraits and sprites.[/size][/center]
Originally, this was an old xnb mod, but it has been my favorite vanilla-style Harvey replacement since the very beginning. So I have converted it for CP and updated the sprites to include a few that were added since the mod was created (reading a red book and sitting on the ground), with permission from the original author.
[b]New November 2023:[/b] Beach sprites and portraits by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/181358142]Orkamaial[/url]! And an updated sleep sprite by me.


[b]Requires:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[/list]
[b]Installation:[/b]
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
 - Unzip the folder and its contents
 - Place into your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder

[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
 - Simply delete the "[CP] Bearish Harvey" folder from your Mods folder


Original Author: [url=https://quartdecarton.tumblr.com/]Quart de Carton[/url]

[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/old-post-in-new-thread-mod-list-modding-guides-and-general-modding-discussion.106868/page-8#post-2795746]Original mod from Chucklefish Forums[/url]
